a real comma after так, a б in the comma slot inside добре
a real comma between two switched words
English word beside a wrong-layout Ukrainian one
apostrophe on the backtick key inside the word; the list knows only the parts "п" and "ять"
apostrophe before the last letter; the list knows only the parts
apostrophe next to б and є, both on punctuation keys; neither part is in the list
typed on the Ukrainian layout meaning English
